title: andropogon exothecus
intro: Andropogon exothecus, commonly known as East Indian bitter grass, is a type of plant species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Andropogon exothecus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and immunomodulatory activities.
